[Pedagogy review · Suggestion · extension · pf-8086360d85]
At p5-magnitude-a-node: Append to p5-magnitude-activity-block: (c) The projectile in part a was launched upwards. Find its velocity components at the highest point. Answer: horizontal 8 m/s, vertical 0 m/s. (d) Find its speed there. Answer: 8 m/s. (e) Explain why its speed cannot fall below 8 m/s during flight. Answer: its horizontal component remains 8 m/s and its speed is sqrt(64 + vertical velocity squared), which is at least 8 m/s.
